testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Kryterion Webassessor

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.
exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. No access to Salesforce org. Proctor monitors via webcam.
renewal_options: Salesforce releases three major updates per year. For each release, certified professionals must complete a free maintenance module on Trailhead to retain their certification. No cost for maintenance.
target_audience: Individuals who have knowledge, skills, and experience architecting and driving multi-cloud B2B solutions that deliver business value for the customer.
recommended_experience: 4–5 years of experience as a Solution Architect with experience with the mentioned Salesforce products.

retake_policy.notes: Retake available after scheduling (no mandatory waiting period for first retake). Retake fee ~$100 for most exams.

objectives.title: Document and articulate the business needs, value, and vision of the customer to support their desired business outcomes.
Define the future blueprint architecture of a B2B multi-cloud Salesforce solution in order to define the product roadmap.
Define the incremental steps necessary to reach the recommended future end state that supports business outcomes.
Define the data flows across systems, the methods and techniques to connect systems, and the relationship each system has to the data it contains.
Define the strategy to migrate data, and synchronize data across systems to support a multi-cloud B2B solution.
Design and map a sharing and visibility model for a B2B multi-cloud Salesforce solution.
Provide governance to satisfy business requirements.
Define the functional and technical solution, in line with Salesforce standards, keeping the business value and objectives in mind.
Recommend an appropriate Salesforce multi-cloud or AppExchange solution.
Identify design options and their associated risks, assess their level of criticality, and recommend the solution that most accurately meets the specified functional and nonfunctional requirements.
Facilitate final acceptance from stakeholders by ensuring any concerns raised are adequately addressed.
Choose the preferred method for integrating data across different clouds.
Define appropriate strategies that balance resources and effort to deliver an effective and efficient delivery method.
Ensure that there is a clear understanding of business requirements through to the delivered configuration.
Provide the appropriate display of the capabilities of that solution to stakeholders (demos) that demonstrate continued alignment with the desired business outcomes and priorities.
Ensure that stakeholders are appropriately enabled to manage the solution moving forward.
Determine how to further improve the solution to ensure business benefits are continuously realized.
Determine how to facilitate adoption in order for the business to benefit from a B2B multi-cloud solution.

editorial.meta_description: The Salesforce Certified B2B Solution Architect exam is scheduled for retirement on 2027-02-01 with no official successor named by Salesforce.
editorial.overview: The Salesforce Certified B2B Solution Architect credential is a professional certification designed for individuals who demonstrate expertise in discovery, customer success, data governance, integration, design, delivery, and operationalizing multi-cloud B2B solutions. Candidates must complete 60 questions within a 105-minute time limit. This exam validates the ability to align complex business requirements with technical implementations across the Salesforce ecosystem, ensuring that architects can successfully manage the entire lifecycle of a B2B solution from initial discovery through to long-term operational success and business adoption.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is intended for experienced architects and senior technical designers who possess a deep understanding of building enterprise-level multi-cloud Salesforce solutions, mapping complex data flows, and aligning diverse business requirements with technical implementations.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare for this exam, candidates should review official Salesforce documentation and study materials covering integration patterns, data modeling, security models, and solution delivery frameworks. It is important to gain familiarity with all five exam domains and their respective weight percentages. Practice applying these concepts to real-world scenarios to ensure you can effectively navigate the 60 questions presented during the test.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses on documenting business needs, articulating the vision of the customer to support outcomes, defining future blueprint architectures for multi-cloud solutions, and mapping out the incremental steps required to reach the desired end state.
study_focus: Document and articulate business needs and vision
Define future blueprint architecture for product roadmaps
Define incremental steps to reach future end state

domain_guidance.summary: This section covers defining data flows across systems, identifying methods to connect systems, designing strategies to migrate and synchronize data across a multi-cloud B2B solution, and mapping the sharing and visibility models for the organization.
study_focus: Define data flows and system connection methods
Design data migration and synchronization strategies

domain_guidance.summary: This domain addresses defining functional and technical solutions that align with Salesforce standards, recommending appropriate multi-cloud or AppExchange options, and identifying design options while assessing associated risks to meet specific functional and nonfunctional business requirements.
study_focus: Identify design options and associated risks

domain_guidance.summary: This domain encompasses defining strategies for balancing resources and effort, ensuring a clear understanding of business requirements through to the final configuration, and providing solution demos to stakeholders to demonstrate alignment with business outcomes.
study_focus: Define strategies to balance delivery resources
Ensure alignment from requirements to configuration

domain_guidance.summary: This domain deals with ensuring stakeholders are appropriately enabled to manage the solution, determining methods to continuously improve the solution to realize business benefits, and facilitating business adoption for the B2B multi-cloud solution.
study_focus: Enable stakeholders to manage the solution
Determine methods to continuously improve the solution

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your 105 minutes carefully across the 60 questions provided. Read each multiple choice or multiple select question with great care before selecting your final answer to ensure accuracy and meet the requirements of the certification.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of exactly 60 linear questions in multiple choice and multiple select formats, which are designed to test your knowledge across five distinct domains of B2B solution architecture.
To successfully pass the exam, you must achieve a score of at least 58 correct answers out of the total number of questions presented during your testing session.
The total allotted duration for the exam is 105 minutes, during which time candidates are expected to complete all 60 questions provided in the linear test format.

faq.question_title: What is the exam price and retake policy?
faq.answer_text: The exam costs 400 dollars to register for an initial attempt. Candidates who are unsuccessful and need to retake the test are subject to a separate retake fee of 100 dollars.
